summary: Erie Indemnity Company operates as a managing attorney-in-fact for the subscribers at the Erie Insurance Exchange in the United States. It provides issuance and renewal services; sales related services, including agent compensation and sales and advertising support services; underwriting services that include underwriting and policy processing; and other services consist of customer services and administrative support services, as well as information technology services. The company was incorporated in 1925 and is based in Erie, Pennsylvania.
summary_fr: Erie Indemnity Company agit en qualité d'avocat-gérant pour les souscripteurs de l'Erie Insurance Exchange aux États-Unis. Elle fournit des services d'émission et de renouvellement ; services liés aux ventes, y compris rémunération des agents et services de soutien aux ventes et à la publicité ; services de souscription qui comprennent la souscription et le traitement des polices ; et autres services comprennent les services à la clientèle et les services de soutien administratif, ainsi que les services informatiques. La société a été constituée en 1925 et est basée à Erie, en Pennsylvanie.
